Automation Opportunity: - Routing fully automated; A/B test of weight-changes before production (W2304)
Controls: - CTL-409: reservation integrity; CTL-197 (ATP accuracy — links to VS-05); operational: Ecom Ops Manager routing-rule sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Suboptimal-routing risk**: the engine picks a fast-but-costly source when a cheaper-but-slightly-slower source would do, eroding margin; mitigated by the cost-optimization feedback in W2293 and the engine weight-tuning
- **ATP-inaccuracy risk**: the engine routes to a source whose ATP is stale (sync lag), causing a post-reservation stock-out; mitigated by the W2306 sync-accuracy monitoring and the <30 min sync SLA
System Touchpoints: - Order management / routing engine (links to VS-08 / W536 unified order management, W534 multi-origin fulfillment) — the source-selection logic
- ATP / inventory (links to VS-05 / W105 multi-channel allocation, VS-60 / W2306 visibility) — the real-time availability per source
- Ecommerce platform (links to VS-10 / W11 BOPIS, W98 order exception) — the order-intake
Time Estimate: ~5 sec/decision automated; Ecom Ops Manager rule-tuning ~4 hours/month = **~50 hours/year** human, system handles the volume.

Automation Opportunity: - Reservation fully automated with atomic-ATP; expiry auto-processed
Controls: - CTL-409: reservation integrity; CTL-197 (atomic-ATP — no double-sell); operational: Inventory Manager reservation-expiry review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double-sell risk**: two channels reserve the same unit simultaneously (sync lag), causing an over-promise; mitigated by the atomic-reservation (single authoritative ATP) and the W2306 sync monitoring

- **Reservation-hogging risk**: a customer reserves (BOPIS) but never picks up, holding inventory for 5 days; mitigated by the reservation-expiry and the restock (the 5-day window balances customer convenience vs. inventory hold cost)

- Inventory (links to VS-05 / W6 cycle counting) — the reserved vs. available split
- Omnichannel sync (links to VS-60 / W2306) — the real-time reservation across channels
Time Estimate: Automated; Inventory Manager ~4 hours/month monitoring = **~50 hours/year**.
